an10.45:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rājā mahesiyā saddhiṃ nisinno hoti,
an10.45:1.5: mahesī vā bhikkhuṃ disvā sitaṃ pātukaroti, bhikkhu vā mahesiṃ disvā sitaṃ pātukaroti.
an10.45:1.7: addhā imesaṃ kataṃ vā karissanti vā ti.
an10.45:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rājā bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo aññataraṃ itthiṃ gantvā na sarati.
an10.45:2.4: na kho idha añño koci pavisati aññatra pabbajitena,
an10.45:2.5: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño antepure aññataraṃ ratanaṃ nassati.
an10.45:3.3: na kho idha añño koci pavisati aññatra pabbajitena,
an10.45:3.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño antepure abbhantarā guyhamantā bahiddhā sambhedaṃ gacchanti.
an10.45:4.3: na kho idha añño koci pavisati aññatra pabbajitena,
an10.45:4.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño antepure pitā vā puttaṃ pattheti putto vā pitaraṃ pattheti.
an10.45:5.3: na kho idha añño koci pavisati aññatra pabbajitena,
an10.45:5.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:5.5: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcamo ādīnavo rājantepurappavesane. 7.
an10.45:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rājā nīcaṭhāniyaṃ ucce ṭhāne ṭhapeti.
an10.45:6.2: Yesan taṃ amanāpaṃ, tesaṃ evaṃ hoti:
an10.45:6.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rājā uccaṭhāniyaṃ nīce ṭhāne ṭhapeti.
an10.45:7.2: Yesan taṃ amanāpaṃ, tesaṃ evaṃ hoti:
an10.45:7.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:7.5: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave sattamo ādīnavo rājantepurappavesane. 9.
an10.45:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rājā akāle senaṃ uyyojeti.
an10.45:8.2: Yesan taṃ amanāpaṃ, tesaṃ evaṃ hoti:
an10.45:8.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rājā kāle senaṃ uyyojetvā antarāmaggato nivattāpeti.
an10.45:9.2: Yesan taṃ amanāpaṃ, tesaṃ evaṃ hoti:
an10.45:9.4: siyā nu kho pabbajitassa kamman ti.
an10.45:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño antepuraṃ hatthisammadaṃ assasammadaṃ rathasammadaṃ, rajanīyāni rūpasaddagandharasaphoṭṭhabbāni, yāni na pabbajitasāruppāni.
an10.45:10.3: Ime kho bhikkhave dasa ādīnavā rājantepurappavesane
